plan_point: 77.44.7.D — basic icon Inspector canonical registry and legacy-value recovery

gap.finding: The basic Icon Inspector maintained a second hard-coded list. It offered unsupported identifiers (arrow, camera, music, globe, mail) and omitted supported identifiers (sparkles, video, calendar, chat, link). Renderer fallback could silently show the star glyph for a different saved identifier, and unsupported values could fail publish validation.
gap.red_test: The new real-browser regression failed before the implementation: actual Inspector IDs were star,heart,play,check,arrow,bolt,camera,music,globe,mail; expected canonical registry IDs were star,heart,check,bolt,play,sparkles,video,calendar,chat,link.

behavior: Icon choices now come from the shared ICON_CHOICES registry used by rendering and validation.

Unsupported legacy IDs stay visible as disabled selected options with a status warning; opening the Inspector does not write the Page Model. Explicit selection of a supported value repairs only the icon while preserving its accessible label.
Desktop and mobile real-browser coverage selects every canonical icon, checks its canvas glyph, and verifies draft Save/reload and separate Publish behavior.
